fix(codex): reject invalid MCP binding names

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-62
  description: |-
    Reject Codex MCP server identities that cannot be represented by the native TurnMcpBinding grammar while loading the operator runtime profile. This keeps the broader provider-neutral identity grammar for other providers and ensures invalid required capabilities fail before picker repository materialization.
    
    Add configuration coverage for dotted and slashed Codex MCP identities.
